validation: Generic WebXR input regression, not physical hardware
handTeleport: release lands tracked viewer at destination without firing
cancel: moving the ray off the floor cancels teleport
trackingLoss: disconnect cancels the armed teleport without moving
home: HUD HOME returns the tracked viewer to the start
gestureNavigation: two-finger pose on ground or HOME never fires or teleports
controller: left-stick movement; one 45° turn per right-stick deflection, around the viewer
desktop: W moves forward; H resets; pause stops movement
